npm_without_nvm.pattern: npm install .* on remote server without nvm
npm_without_nvm.fix: Always use nvm: nvm install --lts && nvm use --lts && npm install

pip_without_venv.pattern: pip install on system python without venv
pip_without_venv.fix: Always use python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate first

certbot_without_nginx_stop.fix: Use certbot --nginx instead, or stop nginx first

apt_without_update.pattern: apt install without apt update first
apt_without_update.fix: Always run apt update before apt install

mysql_root_no_password.pattern: mysql -u root without -p on fresh install
mysql_root_no_password.fix: Use sudo mysql or mysql -u root -p

git_push_without_pull.pattern: git push without git pull on shared repo

chmod_recursive_root.fix: Use specific permissions: chmod 755 for dirs, 644 for files
